test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Much villagers attended the feast hosted by the village panchayat.
solution:
The error is in 'Much villagers' 

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect and has an error of **determiners**.
 
• Here** 'Many villagers'** should be used instead of **'Much villagers'**
 
• **'Much' **is uncountable.__
 __
 
• **Example:** There is too **much** food at home for us. *{ here we cannot count food }
 
 
 
• **'Many' **is countable.__
 __
 
• ​__**Example: ***There are **many **girls in the classroom.*{ here we can count girls }​
 
 

**The correct sentence will be:** ***'****__**Many'** villagers attended the fest hosted by the village panchayat.__* 

__
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 

* **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है और इसमें 'determiners ' की ​ त्रुटि है I
 
• यहां 'Much villagers' के बजाय 'Many villagers' इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए I
 
• 'Much' अगणनीय है।
 
 
• **उदाहरण: **There is too much food at home for us. *{ यहाँ हम भोजन की गिनती नहीं कर सकते }
 
 
 
• 'Many' गणनीय है I
 
 
• उदाहरण: *There are many girls in the classroom.*{ यहाँ हम लड़कियों की गिनती कर सकते हैं }
 
 

**सही वाक्य होगा: ***'**Many' villagers attended the fest hosted by the village panchayat.__* 

__
 
• अत: विकल्प 3 सही उत्तर है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** 

In the given sentence, the word "**hosted**" is functioning as a past participle, which acts as an adjective modifying the noun "**fest**." In this case, there is no need to include "**was/were**" before "hosted" because the sentence is in the active voice and the verb "**hosted**" is describing the fest.

If we were to rephrase the sentence using the passive voice, we could say: "*The fest, which was hosted by the village panchayat, was attended by many villagers."*

In this revised sentence, "**was hosted**" is used to indicate the passive voice, and the verb "**attended**" is in the past tense to match the verb tense of "**was hosted."**

The correct answer is '**effect**'
